translations.web: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
translations.bsb: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.
translations.kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live
translations.asv: Take thou no interest of him or increase, but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
